review.finding: The hook denied the tag push that SKILL.md Step 7 prescribes after gh pr merge --delete-branch, because HEAD is then on main at the merge commit. (Fixed in 049058c4c: a tag-only push and gh release create are judged by the tag's commit; real-git tests for no-ff, squash and a moved tag; re-verified by the second review.)
A quote in the middle of a token (--message="a; git push --tags") and PowerShell here-strings were lexed as commands: false positives during a release. (Fixed, three cases tested.)
gh pr merge by number or URL is judged against local HEAD, not the PR head. (Recorded as known miss, D38.)
git log followed renames and an empty commit passed the event-only rule. (Fixed: --no-renames, per-commit blocks, tests.)
popd and variable cd targets were not handled. (Fixed: treated as unknown and the command passes.)
Trunk tuple differs from release_event.TRUNKS. (Fixed: a subset test pins them.)
git ran for every push before the run state was checked. (Fixed: run state first, test asserts it.)
Round 2: git push --tags with no refspec on main is judged by HEAD, not the tag; the deny reason is wrong, the deny is conservative. (Recorded, not built.)
Round 2: gh release create without --verify-tag can create the remote tag at another commit; same gap as before. (Recorded, not built.)
Round 2: cwd_unknown never resets; cd - and bare cd are not unknown; backslash escape inside PowerShell double quotes. All fail open. (Recorded, not built.)
